sloka: छिद्रम् हि मृगयन्त एते विद्वान्सो ब्रह्म राक्षसाः ।विधिहीनस्य यज्ञस्य सद्यः कर्ता विनश्यति ॥१-१२-१८॥
transliteration: chidram hi mṛgayanta ete vidvānso brahma rākṣasāḥ ।vidhihīnasya yajñasya sadyaḥ kartā vinaśyati ॥1-12-18॥

translations.english: Therefore let the arrangements be made in a manner by which this sacifice is completed in accordance with the prescriptions in scriptures and you are experts in doing so".
translations.hindi: TD ८ ी री ५८ : इस प्रकार बड़े सत्कार के साथ महाराज दशरथ, वहाँ सात- आठ दिनों रह कर, रोमपाद से बोले
